label: Who has the login?
body: The person who knows how to add an event is on holiday, or left in March.

label: Days for one line
body: You email the agency, wait your turn, then check the change and ask again.

label: One wrong click
body: We've seen a client change an event date, press publish and watch the event disappear from the site.

label: Back to square one
body: Every new starter needs CMS training, and the how-to doc is always out of date.
